[[Tahkayun Tsi]] is a [[Mantid]] [[boss]] that appears in [[Kinya Province]]. This boss is easy to [[farm]] even for relatively low level characters, though you should be careful to not [[aggro]] nearby mantids.

== Locations ==
* [[Shing Jea Island]]
** {{NPC location|Kinya Province}}

== Skills ==
5-7 [[Deadly Arts]] (17-19 Deadly Arts in [[Hard mode]])
* {{skill icon|Dark Prison}}
* {{skill icon|Leaping Mantis Sting}}
* {{skill icon|Mantis Touch}}
* {{skill icon|Nine Tail Strike}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Amber Chunk]]
* [[Chitin Fragment]]
* [[Mantid Pincer]]
* [[Monstrous Eye]]
* [[Ruby]]
* [[Tahkayun's Pincers]] ([[unique]])

== Trivia ==
*"Tahkayun" means "Assassin" in the [[Languages of Tyria#Old Canthan|old Canthan language]].
